part: Market + Research list rows — signal-kind / theme tag (README §0.4)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.4: 'Whole row links... Market and Research rows add a signal-kind tag after the type — a tag, never a band.' 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys row-anatomy note ('Market and Research rows add a signal-kind tag after the type — a tag, never a band'); src/components/market/MarketIntelLedger.tsx and src/components/research/ResearchLedger.tsx (real components, one real row each — the same fixture shapes ../smoke/market-rows-smoke.mjs and research-rows-smoke.mjs already prove render without crashing)
notes: CONFIRMED live, not from source reading alone: MarketIntelLedger.tsx correctly appends a TagChip carrying the row's `signalKindLabel` (e.g. 'Cost alert') inside the row's meta line, alongside the type text — this is a POSITIVE finding, matching README §0.4 exactly. Checked below as the 'market row — signal-kind TagChip present' target, expected to read MATCH.

CONFIRMED live: ResearchLedger.tsx passes `meta: metaLine(r)` (src/lib/dashboard/row-fields.ts), which joins only `type`, `modes`, and `topic` — never a theme or kind. ResearchLedger.tsx does not import TagChip at all (confirmed by grep of the file). Research's theme classification (THEME_KEYS/assignTheme, src/lib/research/taxonomy.mjs) exists ONLY as a secondaryFacetGroups filter (the 'Theme' facet row), never rendered as a per-row chip — so the fixture's row meta line reads the bare word 'research_finding' with no theme tag beside it. This is a real gap against README §0.4's stated rule for Research specifically (Market and Research are named as a PAIR: 'Market and Research rows add a signal-kind tag'), checked below as a NOT BUILT target — the selector states the contract ResearchLedger.tsx would need to satisfy it (a TagChip in the row's meta line, mirroring MarketIntelLedger's own SignalRow), not an invented pixel value.
